label: The withholding holder is a willed two-way giver, by its HAS_INTELLECT_1 and one power
description: Argument B: the withholding holder gives by an owned rational power, excluding the formally defined CHANCE_3 branch under its intellect, one-power and full creator/withholding bundle, without a Theta 5 principle. Constructive, not a transcription; establishes no premise. The omission controls preserve their scopes: withholding intellect permits the non-rational-power assignment with the remaining premises; withholding one power permits the intellectual chancer. Holder-root identification has its separate conditional support in docs/notes/holder-root-identification.md. The recipient-directed creation-by-will statement a94c5dfc still needs its own Wills/recipient-good bridge; neither that bridge nor operative intentionality is supplied by the existing root consumer.
